items.statement: The director appoints the mentor, who develops the program and guides, monitors, and evaluates the trainee.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Mentor izrađuje program uvođenja u posao, stručno vodi, pomaže, prati i ocjenjuje uspješnost pripravnika u provođenju programa.

items.statement: Trainees receive a defined program covering quality-system principles and job-specific processes, resources, organization, and work methods.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: - temeljna načela sustava za upravljanje kvalitetom.

items.statement: A qualified mentor evaluates work output, quality, understanding, planning, initiative, and interpersonal performance at the end of training.

sources.source_locator: 6.3 Praćenje i ocjenjivanje uspješnosti, page 5, lines 170-188

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Iz vrednovanja navedenih elemenata proizlazi konačna ocjena uspješnosti pripravničkog staža. Ocjenu treba pismeno obrazložiti.

items.statement: The trainee maintains an internship diary and reports monthly progress to the mentor.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Pripravnik je dužan voditi evidenciju (dnevnik stažiranja) o provođenju pripravničkog programa.
